Nadia: quick thread from today's all-hands runtime Q&A. collecting notes and open questions about batching defaults, cache persistence, and kernel rollout sequencing. please reply if you need clarifications. :wave:

Evan: two quick ones: 1) will continuous batching be on by default for Hosted routes? 2) can we set per-route exemptions?

Rohit: answers: default=on for throughput-optimized models, but yes per-route exemptions supported via model profile. small-chat routes will be exempted by default to avoid added latency.

Claire: about KV/prefix caching 3 is persistence going to be enabled for Dedicated customers only or hosted too? also curious about snapshot frequency.

Rohit: persistence plan: Dedicated -> optional persistent snapshots to S3-like stores; Hosted -> ephemeral per-host caches initially. snapshot frequency for Dedicated will be configurable, defaulting to 5m async snapshots.

Nadia: any expected degradations to p95/p99 during snapshot windows?

Rohit: minimal on p95. p99 could see occasional spikes if heavy eviction coincides with snapshot thrash; mitigations: staggered snapshots and backpressure on background IO.

Evan: kernel priorities: is fused-attn ahead of int8 GEMM work? customers keep asking when int8 will reduce cost.

Rohit: priority is fused-attn first (largest latency win on long-seq models). int8/GEMM runs on parallel stream but with smaller team. customers will see staged rollouts per-hardware.

Claire: rollout model for Dedicated? opt-in, canary, then default? what about fallback if a kernel OOMs?

Rohit: yes: opt-in model-profile -> canary (5% on staging) -> larger canary -> default. if OOM detected we auto-fallback to safe kernel and record incident metrics; operators get alerted.

ops-bot: action created: "canary-run-fused-attn" assigned to Rohit, due 1782347600.

Nadia: last ask 3 can we get a short one-pager for Product/Docs summarizing opt-in steps, expected fallbacks, and SKU compatibility notes?

Rohit: will produce a one-pager and link to the model-profile JSON schema. aiming to share by EOD tomorrow.

Evan: thanks, please ping here when canary metrics are in.

Claire: +1, add me to review.

Nadia: thanks everyone, closing the loop. :thumbsup:
